title: A Unified Poisson Summation Framework for Generalized Quantum Matrix Transformations
summary: We present a unified algorithmic framework for quantum simulation of non-unitary dynamics and matrix functions, governed by the principle of spectral aliasing derived from the Poisson Summation Formula (PSF).
